phone_snatch.name: Phone Snatch
phone_snatch.blurb: Screen out, headphones in, no clue you're there. On the shoulder and gone.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.blurb: Busy crowd, loose jacket, wallet sitting proud in the back pocket.

shoplift.name: Shoplift
shoplift.blurb: Corner shop, one bored bossman, blind spot by the fridges.

burglary.name: Burglary
burglary.blurb: Terraced gaff, lights off, curtains open. Somebody's on holiday.

approach.label: Go quiet
approach.blurb: Back window, slow and clean. Less in the bag, less noise.

approach.label: Kick it in
approach.blurb: Front door, grab everything, out in ninety seconds.

approach.label: Come back later
approach.blurb: Neighbour's twitching the curtain. Bottle it — lose nothing.

corner_shotting.name: Corner Shotting
corner_shotting.blurb: Hold the block, serve the fiends, clock the undercover before he clocks you.

chop_run.name: Chop Run
chop_run.blurb: Delroy wants a grey German saloon, E-plates, no scratches. It's parked up on the high road.

approach.label: Tow it quiet
approach.blurb: Flatbed at 4am. Slow money, cold trail.

approach.label: Hotwire & drive
approach.blurb: In and gone. Faster, hotter, better paid.

extortion.name: Extortion
extortion.blurb: Lean on the stalls for their weekly. Most pay. Some need convincing.

protection.name: Protection Round
protection.blurb: Shops pay to stay standing. You're the reason they stay standing.

grow_harvest.name: Grow-Op Harvest
grow_harvest.blurb: Attic full of product, lamps humming. Cut it, bag it, move it before the smell does.

counterfeit.name: Counterfeit Run
counterfeit.blurb: Pallet of fakes, real margins. Move it before anyone checks the stitching.

card_fraud.name: Card Cloning
card_fraud.blurb: Skimmer on the cashpoint, numbers in the burner. Cash out before the bank clocks it.

ram_raid.name: ATM Ram-Raid
ram_raid.blurb: Van in reverse, cashpoint out the wall, ninety seconds till armed response.

approach.label: 4am, empty streets
approach.blurb: Quiet as it gets. Smaller take.

approach.label: Go now, go loud
approach.blurb: Broad strokes. Big money, big noise.

approach.label: Abort
approach.blurb: Too many eyes. Live to raid another night.

warehouse.name: Warehouse Job
warehouse.blurb: Pallets of gear behind a roller shutter and two bored guards. Stealth or speed.

approach.label: Bang the door, race the clock

smuggle.name: Container Smuggle
smuggle.blurb: Container off the ship, off the manifest. Get it off the dock before the check.

gun_deal.name: Strap Deal
gun_deal.blurb: Nottingham plug, back of a car park. Straps are loud money and days of heat.
